expectedFindings.title: Unprotected Counter.Add mutates shared n without a lock
expectedFindings.body: Add does c.n += delta with no mutex or atomic. Concurrent worker-pool callers race on n; Value() also reads n unsynchronized. The proposed.diff removes the previous sync.Mutex.
expectedFindings.triggerCondition: Two or more goroutines call Add or mix Add and Value on the same Counter.
expectedFindings.correctnessBasis: Go memory model: concurrent unsynchronized read/write of c.n is a data race. Observed in the committed fixture diff, not inferred from history.
